Start the Word-to-PDF conversion.
Download the PDF and check its pages.
faqs: Can I upload both DOC and DOCX?
The tool accepts Word documents in DOC and DOCX formats.
Can I edit the PDF like a Word document?
PDFs use a fixed page layout. Keep the original Word file for later revisions.
Why might the converted PDF look different?
Fonts, page breaks or document features can render differently. Inspect the output instead of assuming an exact match.

name: PDF to Excel
title: PDF to Excel Converter
description: Extract PDF content into an Excel workbook. Upload a PDF, convert it to XLSX and review cells and tables before using the data.

steps: Select the PDF containing your data.
Convert the PDF to an Excel workbook.
Download the XLSX file and verify the cells.
faqs: What format does PDF to Excel produce?
The conversion produces an XLSX workbook that can be opened in a compatible spreadsheet application.
Will every table become a clean spreadsheet?
PDF table structures vary. Rows and columns may need correction after conversion.
Can I rely on extracted financial figures?
Check each important figure against the original PDF before calculating or making decisions.

name: Excel to PDF

description: Convert an Excel workbook to a PDF document. Upload an XLS or XLSX file and inspect the resulting page layout before sharing.

steps: Choose your XLS or XLSX workbook.
Run the Excel-to-PDF conversion.
Download the PDF and inspect the sheet layout.
faqs: Which spreadsheet formats are accepted?
Upload an Excel workbook in XLS or XLSX format.
Does the PDF retain spreadsheet formulas?
The PDF displays rendered content, not an editable calculation model. Keep the workbook if you need formulas.
What should I check after exporting a wide sheet?
Inspect page breaks and look for clipped columns or small text before sharing the PDF.

name: PowerPoint to PDF
title: PowerPoint to PDF Converter
description: Create a PDF from a PowerPoint presentation. Upload a PPT or PPTX file, convert it and review the exported slides.
why: Share presentation pages with someone who does not need to edit the slides. A PDF is a static document, so review the deck without its animations.
steps: Upload a PPT or PPTX presentation.
Convert the presentation into PDF pages.
Download the PDF and check each slide.
faqs: Can I convert a PPTX presentation?
The tool accepts PPT and PPTX files for conversion to PDF.
Will slide animations work in the PDF?
A PDF export contains static pages rather than interactive slide animations.
Should I keep the original presentation?
Yes. Keep the PPT or PPTX source for editing slides, notes and presentation effects.

name: PDF to PowerPoint
title: PDF to PowerPoint Converter
description: Convert a PDF into a PowerPoint file. Upload your document, download the PPTX result and review the converted slides.
why: Use a presentation file as a starting point for arranging document content into slides. Review the output; conversion is not a reconstruction of the original deck.
steps: Select the PDF you want to use in a presentation.
Run conversion to a PowerPoint file.
Download the PPTX and review it in a slide editor.
faqs: What file will I download?
The tool returns a PPTX presentation after a successful conversion.
Will all PDF content become editable slide objects?
The result depends on the source and conversion. Do not assume that every image or text element can be edited independently.
Can this restore the original presentation effects?
A PDF does not preserve the original slide animations or transitions, so those effects cannot be recovered from it.

The converter currently exports each page as PNG and packages the images in a ZIP archive.

Not currently. The existing tool exports PNG files. This page does not offer a JPG output selector.
Will I be able to select text in a page image?
A page image contains pixels, not selectable document text. Use OCR PDF when you need recognized text.

name: JPG to PDF
title: JPG to PDF Converter

why: Put related photos or image scans into one document instead of sending separate files. Arrange the pictures in the order you want readers to see.
steps: Select the images you want in the PDF.
Arrange the images and create the document.
Download the PDF and inspect the page order.
faqs: Can I put several JPG files into one PDF?
Yes. The images-to-PDF tool accepts multiple images for a single document.
Are formats other than JPG accepted?
The uploader also accepts supported formats such as PNG. Check the input list shown by the tool.
Does this recognize words in photographed pages?
Creating a PDF from images does not by itself recognize text. Use OCR PDF separately if you need text recognition.

name: HTML to PDF
title: HTML to PDF Converter
description: Convert an uploaded HTML file into a PDF. Review the generated pages and check any images, fonts or external resources.
why: Create a paginated copy of HTML content for reading or sharing as a document. Web layouts and printed layouts differ, so inspect the export.
steps: Upload the HTML file you want to convert.
Run the HTML-to-PDF conversion.
Download the PDF and review its rendered content.
faqs: Do I upload a file or enter a website address?
This tool accepts an HTML file through its uploader.
Will external images and fonts appear?
External resources may be unavailable during rendering. Check the PDF rather than assuming every resource loaded.
Will the PDF remain an interactive website?
No. The result is a document rendering, not a live website with its original interactive behavior.

name: Merge PDF
title: Merge PDF Files Online
description: Combine multiple PDF documents into one file. Choose your PDFs, arrange their order and download the merged document.
why: Keep related documents together in a single PDF. Set the file order before merging to make the combined document easier to read.
steps: Select the PDF files you want to combine.
Arrange their order and start merging.
Download the merged PDF and verify its pages.
faqs: Do I need more than one PDF to merge?
Merging is intended to combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
Does the order of my files matter?
Yes. Review and arrange the file order before creating the merged PDF.
Can I remove unwanted pages after merging?
Use Delete PDF Pages on the merged document to remove pages you do not need.

name: Split PDF
title: Split PDF into Single-Page Files
description: Split a PDF into individual one-page PDF files, packaged in a ZIP. Upload the document, process it and extract the downloaded archive.
why: Access each document page as a separate PDF. This workflow exports all pages; it does not offer a page-range selector.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to separate into pages.
Start splitting to create a PDF for every page.
Download the ZIP and extract the one-page PDFs.
faqs: What does the Split PDF download contain?
It contains a ZIP archive with one separate PDF file for each page of the source document.
Can I select a page range in this workflow?
Not currently. The tool exports every page. You can keep the individual files you need after extracting the archive.
Will I lose the source PDF?
The tool creates an output archive without overwriting the source file on your device. Keep the original PDF for later use.

name: Compress PDF
title: Compress PDF Files Online
description: Process a PDF with the compression tool. Download the result and compare its file size and readability with the original document.
why: A smaller PDF can be easier to attach or upload. Compression results depend on the document, and size reduction can affect image detail.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to compress.
Start the compression process.
Download the result and compare size and readability.
faqs: How much smaller will my PDF become?
There is no fixed reduction for every document. The result depends on its images, structure and the compression process.
Can compression change image quality?
Yes. Review diagrams, small print and photographs after compression.
What if the compressed PDF is not smaller?
Some files already use efficient compression. Keep the original if the result does not suit your needs.

name: Edit PDF

Use the available editing controls to make changes.
Export the edited PDF and review the affected pages.
faqs: What can I change in the PDF editor?
Use the controls provided by the editor for supported on-page edits, text, drawing and document annotations.
Is every PDF text element editable?
Text extraction depends on the PDF. Scans and some document structures may need a different approach.
Does the editor overwrite my original document?
The editor exports a result file. Keep the original PDF as a separate copy.

name: Rotate PDF

Download the PDF and check the orientation of all its pages.
faqs: Can I choose a page or rotation angle?
Not currently. This workflow sets every page's rotation to 90 degrees clockwise; it has no page or angle selector.
Will rotating a scan recognize its text?
No. Rotation and text recognition are different tasks; use OCR PDF for recognition.
What should I check after rotating pages?
Check every page, including any pages that were already rotated. The workflow sets a fixed rotation rather than adding an angle to the existing rotation.

name: Crop PDF
title: Crop PDF Pages Online
description: Adjust the visible area of PDF pages in your browser. Set the crop, apply it and review the downloaded document.
why: Reduce unwanted page margins or focus the visible page area. Cropping is not a secure method for removing confidential content.
steps: Open the PDF you want to crop.
Set the page crop using the preview controls.
Export the PDF and review the visible area.
faqs: Can cropping trim wide page margins?
Use the crop controls to change the visible page area and inspect the preview before exporting.
Does cropping securely delete hidden information?
Do not treat cropping as redaction. Content outside a visible crop can remain in a PDF.
How is PDF cropping different from image cropping?
PDF cropping changes a document page's visible boundary. Image cropping creates an image with a changed pixel area.

name: Sign PDF
title: Add a Signature to a PDF
description: Place a signature on a PDF in your browser. Position it on the page, export the document and check the result.
why: Add a visible signature to a document using the available signature controls. Confirm the receiving party's requirements before relying on it.
steps: Open the PDF that needs a signature.
Create or choose a signature and position it on the page.
Save the signed PDF and review its placement.
faqs: Is this a certificate-based digital signature?
This tool places a visible signature on the page. Do not assume it provides certificate-based identity verification.
Can I move the signature before exporting?
Use the editor's placement controls to position the signature before saving.
Is the signature legally valid for every document?
Requirements vary by document and jurisdiction. Ask the receiving party what signing method it accepts.

name: Watermark PDF
title: Add a Watermark to a PDF
description: Add a watermark to PDF pages in your browser. Adjust its placement, export the result and check that the document remains readable.
why: Mark a document with a label or visual identifier. A watermark is a visible annotation, not a guarantee against copying or reuse.
steps: Open the PDF to watermark.
Set the watermark content and placement.
Export the PDF and inspect its readability.
faqs: Can a watermark stop someone copying my PDF?
No. A visible watermark labels the document but does not prevent copying.
What should I check before saving a watermark?
Check that its size and position do not obscure important text or diagrams.
Does watermarking replace the original document text?
The watermark adds a visible mark. It is not a tool for securely deleting document content.

name: Add Image to PDF
title: Add an Image to a PDF Online
description: Place an image on a PDF page in your browser. Adjust its size and position, save the document and inspect the result.
why: Add a logo, picture or other visual element to an existing document. Check the image placement and the surrounding page content.
steps: Open the PDF and select the image to insert.
Position and resize the image on the page.
Save the PDF and check the inserted image.
faqs: Can I add a logo to an existing PDF?
Select a supported image file, then use the page controls to place it in the document.
Does the inserted picture become editable text?
No. An inserted image remains an image rather than recognized document text.
What if my picture covers important content?
Move or resize it before exporting, then review the result to check that the original content remains readable.

name: Delete PDF Pages
title: Delete Pages from a PDF
description: Remove unwanted PDF pages in your browser. Select the pages to delete, save a new document and verify the remaining page order.
why: Remove blank sheets or pages you do not want to share. Keep a copy of the original document in case you need the removed pages later.
steps: Open the PDF containing unwanted pages.
Select the pages you want to remove.
Save the result and verify the remaining pages.
faqs: Can I remove a blank page from a PDF?
Choose that page in the deletion controls, then review the remaining pages before exporting.
Will this edit text within the remaining pages?
No. This tool removes selected pages rather than modifying text inside the pages you keep.
Should I keep a backup before deleting pages?
Yes. Save the output separately from the source so you can recover pages from the original document.

name: OCR PDF
title: OCR PDF: Recognize Scanned Text
description: Recognize text in scanned PDF pages using browser-based OCR. Review the extracted words and export an available result format.
why: Turn photographed or scanned words into recognized text. OCR can misread letters, numbers and layout, so proofreading is part of the process.
steps: Open the scanned PDF in the OCR tool.
Choose the recognition options and process the pages.
Review the recognized text and export the result.
faqs: What does OCR do to a scanned PDF?
OCR attempts to recognize words from the page images so you can work with the resulting text.
Is recognized text always accurate?
No. Scan quality, language, handwriting and layout affect recognition. Review important text and numbers.
Can OCR recover every table or document layout?
Text recognition does not guarantee that the original table structure or visual layout will be reconstructed.

name: Compress Image
title: Compress Images Online
description: Process an image with the compression tool. Download the result and compare its file size and visible detail with the original.
why: Prepare an image for an upload limit or smaller attachment. Compare the resulting file size and visible detail before replacing the source.
steps: Upload the image you want to compress.
Start image compression.
Download the result and compare size and detail.
faqs: Will every image become much smaller?
No. The source format, existing compression and processing determine the resulting size.
Can compression affect visible detail?
Yes. Check text, edges and small features in the downloaded image.
Should I discard the original picture?
Keep the original if you may need a higher-quality version for printing or later editing.

name: Convert Image
title: Convert Images to PNG Online
description: Convert supported images to PNG using the web tool. Upload your picture, run conversion and inspect the downloaded PNG image.
why: Create a PNG version of an image for an app or document that accepts that format. This web workflow currently uses PNG output without a format selector.

Start conversion to the workflow's PNG output format.
Download the PNG and verify that it opens correctly.
faqs: Can I select JPG or another output format here?
The current web workflow does not expose an output-format selector. It uses PNG output.
Does PNG conversion recover transparency from a JPG?
No. PNG can represent transparency, but conversion does not recover transparency that was absent from the source.
Does changing the format improve image resolution?
Format conversion alone does not recover detail missing from the source image.

name: Crop Image
title: Crop Images in Your Browser
description: Trim an image to the area you need. Set the crop in your browser, download the result and keep the original for later edits.
why: Focus a picture on its subject or remove unwanted edges. Inspect the crop before saving because content outside the selection is excluded from the output.
steps: Choose an image to open in the crop tool.
Adjust the crop area around the content you need.
Download the cropped image and check its framing.
faqs: Will the crop change the image dimensions?
The exported image uses the selected crop area, which can change its pixel dimensions.
Can I recover cropped-out areas from the output?
Keep the original image. The cropped output does not include areas outside your selected crop.
Is cropping the same as resizing?
No. Cropping selects an area; resizing changes the dimensions of the image content.

name: Resize Image
title: Resize Images in Your Browser
description: Change an image's dimensions using browser-based resizing. Set the output size, save the image and verify its width and height.
why: Fit an image to a form, document or layout that requires particular dimensions. Check the aspect ratio to avoid unintended stretching.
steps: Open the image you want to resize.
Set the dimensions using the resize controls.
Download the resized image and check its dimensions.
faqs: What is the difference between dimensions and file size?
Dimensions are width and height in pixels. File size is the amount of stored data; both can change during resizing.
Can enlarging a small picture restore missing detail?
Ordinary resizing cannot recover detail absent from the source. Enlarged images may look blurred.
How can I avoid stretching my image?
Use the tool's aspect-ratio controls where available and inspect the result before saving.

name: Rotate Image
title: Rotate Images in Your Browser
description: Change a picture's orientation in your browser. Set the rotation, save the image and inspect the downloaded result.
why: Correct an image that appears sideways or upside down before including it in a document. Check the orientation in the exported file, not only the preview.
steps: Open the image with the wrong orientation.
Choose the rotation using the image controls.
Download the result and confirm its direction.
faqs: Can I correct a sideways photo?
Use the rotation controls to turn the picture, then inspect the preview and exported image.
Will rotation recognize text in a photo?
No. Turning the image does not perform text recognition.
Why should I check the downloaded image too?
Different viewers can interpret image orientation metadata differently. Open the exported file to verify the result.

name: Remove Background
title: Remove an Image Background
description: Remove the background from a supported image. Process your picture, inspect the subject edges and download the result.
why: Prepare a subject image for use against another background. Fine edges, hair and similar foreground/background colors may need extra review.
steps: Upload the image whose background you want to remove.
Run background removal and inspect the preview.
Download the result and check the subject edges.
faqs: Will the subject be separated perfectly?
No. Results depend on the picture. Review fine edges and areas where subject and background colors overlap.
What should I check around hair or small details?
Look for missing foreground areas or remaining background pixels before using the result.
Can I add the result to a PDF?
Use Add Image to PDF with a supported downloaded image, and check the placement in the document.

name: Upscale Image
title: Upscale Images Online
description: Increase an image's output dimensions with the upscaling tool. Process the picture and compare the result with the source.
why: Try a larger image for a layout that needs more pixels. Inspect the output closely: added pixels are not proof of recovered original detail.
steps: Upload the image you want to enlarge.
Select the available upscaling options and process it.
Download the result and compare it with the source.
faqs: Does upscaling guarantee a sharper picture?
No. The result depends on the source and processing. Compare edges, text and texture after enlarging.
Can upscaling recover unreadable text?
Do not rely on it to reconstruct missing or unreadable information. Verify important text against the source.
How is upscaling different from compression?
Upscaling increases output dimensions; compression aims to reduce stored file size. They address different needs.

name: Lock PDF

why: Use a password when you want a PDF reader to request one before opening the document. Keep the password somewhere you can retrieve it.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to protect.
Enter a password and run the lock tool.
Download the protected PDF and test the password.
faqs: Should I save the password?
Keep a copy of the password separately from the document so you can open it later.
Does a password guarantee nobody can copy the document?
Do not treat password protection as a guarantee against every form of copying or disclosure.
Can I remove a password later?
Use Unlock PDF with the required password and verify the downloaded result.

name: Unlock PDF
title: Remove a PDF Password
description: Remove password protection from a PDF you are authorized to access. Enter the required password, process the file and check the result.
why: Create an unprotected copy when you have permission and no longer need a password prompt. Store the resulting document appropriately.
steps: Upload the PDF you are authorized to unlock.
Provide the required password and process the document.
Download the result and test that it opens.
faqs: Can this recover a forgotten password?
The tool is not a password-recovery guarantee. Provide the password requested by the workflow.
May I unlock someone else's document?
Only process documents you are authorized to access and modify.
Does unlocking edit the document pages?
Removing password protection is separate from editing page content. Review the output after processing.

name: Compress Video
title: Compress Video Files Online
description: Reduce a video's file size with the available compression levels. Upload the video, process it and compare playback with the original.
why: Prepare a video for a smaller attachment or upload. Compression can affect picture and sound quality, so inspect the result before replacing your source.
steps: Upload a supported video file.
Select a compression level and start processing.
Download the video and check playback and file size.
faqs: Is the size reduction the same for every video?
No. Duration, source bitrate and selected compression level affect the result.
Can compression take longer for large videos?
Yes. Processing time depends on the video and the server workload; there is no fixed completion-time guarantee.
Should I check the audio as well as the picture?
Play the downloaded video and review sound, picture and synchronization before using it.
